name: Player
lead: A player in the room: what `players.on_join` and every player event hand you.

functions.name: ride
functions.signature: player:ride(thing: MountTarget, opts: { seat: number ?, locked: boolean ? }?) → boolean
functions.description: The player's name. The account's own id: the one name for a player a rename does not change. Where they stand now. Your own table, kept on the player for as long as they are connected. A player is one value while connected: `a == b` and `t[player]` work. The Room the player is in; nil while they move between rooms. Degrees: `yaw` sideways, `pitch` up or down; live, read only. True while the player sneaks; live. `attack` is the left button held on a block in reach (see player.reach); a client says nothing about a button held on air. True while the player sits on something; live. Seat 1 drives a vehicle; `locked` keeps a sneak from getting them off. `false` when somebody sits in that seat; keeps the current ride on failure. Works immediately after creating the target. Repeating the same ride keeps the seat; no delay or extra movement is needed.

functions.name: dismount
functions.description: Gets the player off what they ride; sneaking does the same, as off a horse.

functions.name: message
functions.description: What shows on this player's screen: the calls `ui` has, for them alone, plus their own menu and overlay. Sends a chat line to this player alone; `color` is for the words that did not pick one. Chat is not part of the screen, so it is not in `ui`.

functions.name: sound
functions.signature: player:sound(name: string, opts: { at: Vec3 ?, volume: number ?, pitch: number ?, category: string ?, }?)
functions.description: Plays a sound by name to this player only, with an optional position, volume, pitch and category.

functions.name: teleport
functions.description: Yaw and pitch left out keep the way they face.

functions.name: move_to
functions.description: Moves the player to another room; the client swaps worlds in place.

functions.name: travel
functions.description: Sends the player to another world of the group, at `pos` or its spawn.

functions.name: give
functions.description: One item: "stone", or { item = "arrow", count = 16 }.

functions.name: held
functions.description: Returns the stack in hand ({ item, count }, plus `id` for a pack item and `damage` for a worn tool), or nil.

functions.name: inventory
functions.description: Returns one { item, count } row per filled slot.

functions.name: take
functions.description: Up to `count` (1 unless you say) of what matches, the hand first; answers how many it took.

functions.name: set_held
functions.description: The stack in hand, replaced; nil or false empties the hand.

functions.name: hotbar
functions.description: Replaces the nine hotbar slots; a missing index is empty.

functions.name: wear
functions.description: The four armour slots; a piece left out is bare.

functions.name: kill
functions.description: 0..20, or nil where the game version has no food bar. The food saturation, or nil where the game version has no food bar. True while the player is on the death screen. Kills the player; returns false on a version with no damage rules.

functions.name: hide
functions.description: This player stops seeing `other`, or sees them again.

functions.name: show
functions.description: This player sees `other` again after a `hide`.

functions.name: can_see
functions.description: True unless `other` is not visible or is hidden from this player.

functions.name: effect
functions.signature: player:effect(name: string, opts: { level: number ?, duration: number ?, particles: boolean ? }?)
functions.description: A potion effect by its modern name; `duration` in seconds, math.huge for ever.

functions.name: clear_effect
functions.description: Takes a potion effect off the player, by its modern name.

functions.name: push
functions.description: A shove in blocks per tick, on top of what they are doing.

functions.name: damage
functions.description: A hit in half-hearts: the flash, the sound, the resistance window. `false` on a version with no damage rules.

functions.name: look_at
functions.description: Turns the player's head to a point, where they stand.

functions.name: stop_sound
functions.description: Where their view is from: the camera they look out of, or their eyes. One sound by name, or every sound; 1.13 and later.

functions.name: kick
functions.description: Disconnects the player, with that text on their screen.

functions.name: connect
functions.description: Asks Minefort to move the player to another server by name: an instance's `id`, the network's name (its default member) or "hub". Minefort decides and does not answer; a player still here was not moved.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Returns how many of an item the player carries, across every slot.

functions.name: has
functions.description: True if the player's groups give them this permission node; operators have every node.

functions.name: groups
functions.description: Returns the player's groups; `default` is not listed.

functions.name: add_group
functions.description: Puts the player in a group until they leave; errors on a group citadel.yml does not define.

functions.name: remove_group
functions.description: Takes the player out of a group.

functions.name: supports
functions.description: True if this player's client can show the feature.

functions.name: look
functions.description: Returns the unit vector the player faces.

functions.name: set_slot
functions.description: Selects hotbar slot 1..9.

fields.name: gamemode
fields.description: The hotbar slot in hand, 1..9; live. 0 survival, 1 creative, 2 adventure, 3 spectator; writable.

fields.name: spawn_point
fields.description: The player's own respawn point (the block of the position), or nil for the room's. Writable; a point a pack sets needs no bed. nil clears it, a bed's point too.

fields.name: max_health
fields.description: Their health now, 0 to `max_health`; nil where the game version has no damage rules. Writable: set outright, no flash; 0 is a death; a number above `max_health` stops there. The most health they can have: 20 unless a pack set it; nil where the game version has no damage rules. Writable, 1 to 1024; nil gives the game's own back. A lower maximum takes `health` down to it. It lasts for the session. Every Java client draws its hearts; Bedrock draws none.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: The body: what a pack sets on a player. See docs/luau-api.md, "Body and movement". Walk speed as a multiple of normal; 0 pins them.

fields.name: can_fly
fields.description: May fly in a mode that cannot.

fields.name: visible
fields.description: false: no other player is sent this body. The tab line stays. true or nil shows the body again.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: 1/16 to 16; 1.20.5 and later, older clients stay as they are.

fields.name: reach
fields.description: How far a block can be clicked or dug, 0 to 64 blocks (4.5 by default); 1.20.5 and later. Measured from the camera when there is one.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The experience bar: the number over it, and how full it is (0..1).

fields.name: xp
fields.description: How full the experience bar is, 0..1.

fields.name: camera
fields.description: What they look out of: a camera from camera.fixed/free/orbit/chase, or nil or false for their own eyes. No delay is needed after creating its target. Ends when the target is destroyed or the player leaves the room.
